senses.gloss: m. (נָקַר I) bite, trace of a bite.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:16">Tosef. Ter. VII, 16</cite> <he>נ׳ בתאינה וכ׳</he> if there was a bite to be seen in a fig, and it shrivelled (v. <cite ref="C01292"><he>גְּרוֹגֶרֶת</he></cite>,—which is an indication that it was not a serpent’s bite). Y. ib. VIII, 46ᵃ top <he>מקום הנ׳ אכלו</he> they (the birds) ate from a spot which had been bitten at (by a serpent); a. e.—V. <cite ref="N00770"><he>נִיקּוּר</he></cite>.
